delete.description: Removes the record, original, preview, assessments, revised DOCX, revision notices and processing checkpoints in any state. A queued or processing document stops: no later result is saved, an active rewrite reservation is released once, and the worker sends no further requests for it, but text already sent to DeepSeek may still be processed there and its answer is discarded. Usage records stay unchanged, so deleting a completed document never restores allowance. Once the document is gone, repeating the request returns the same 404 as a document that never existed.
